# MLOps

Model2 is built using the `sampregdata.csv` dataset where the model inputs are `x2` and `x4` to predict our predictor variable of `y`. It was trained on 80% of the data and tested on 20% which resulted in an R-squared value of 0.49. This is then compared to the intial model where only one input was chose of `x4` and resuled in an R-squared of 0.27. These statistics shows us that the model with two variables, significantly outperforms the model with just one.
